70000.commentary: (MNa) vuṭṭhāniman'ti vipākavuṭṭhānavedanaṃ. sā kira mahāniraye vedanāto dukkhatarā hoti, yathā hi sinehapānasatt'āhato parihārasatt'āhaṃ dukkhataraṃ, evaṃ mahānirayadukkhato ussade vipākavuṭṭhānavedanā dukkhatarā'ti vadanti. (MNt) vuṭṭhāniman'ti vuṭṭhāne bhavaṃ, antiman'ti attho. ten'āha, vipākavuṭṭhānavedanan'ti, vipākassa pariyosānaṃ vedanan'ti attho.

examples.text: dasavassasahassāni tass'eva mahānirayassa ussade apacciṃ vuṭṭhānimaṃ nāma vedanaṃ vediyamāno. tassa mayhaṃ, pāpima, evarūpo kāyo hoti, seyyathā'pi manussassa. evarūpaṃ sīsaṃ hoti, seyyathā'pi macchassa.

70001.meaning1: helping to rehabilitate; helping up again

examples.text: bhikkhū'pi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti sahadhammena, evaṃ saṃvaddhā hi tassa bhagavato parisā yadidaṃ aññam'aññavacanena aññam'aññavuṭṭhāpanenā'ti

70005.grammar: prp of caus pass of ud √ṭhā, caus, pass, intrans

examples.text: ambho purisa, na tvaṃ addasa manussesu itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā ābādhikaṃ dukkhitaṃ bāḷhagilānaṃ, sake muttakarīse palipannaṃ semānaṃ, aññehi vuṭṭhāpiyamānaṃ, aññehi saṃvesiyamānan'ti?

70006.meaning1: should be raised; should be lifted up
70006.meaningLit: to cause to be stood up

examples.text: ime te, ambho purisa, cattāro āsīvisā uggatejā ghoravisā kālena kālaṃ vuṭṭhāpetabbā, kālena kālaṃ nhāpetabbā, kālena kālaṃ bhojetabbā, kālena kālaṃ saṃvesetabbā.
evaṃ vutte daṇḍapāṇi sakko sīsaṃ okampetvā, jivhaṃ nillāḷetvā, tivisākhaṃ nalāṭikaṃ nalāṭe vuṭṭhāpetvā daṇḍam'olubbha pakkāmi.

70010.meaning1: having helped (somebody) to rise above; having caused to emerge (from)
70010.commentary: (ANa) saddhammā vuṭṭhāpetvā'ti dasakusalakammapathadhammato vuṭṭhāpetvā. (NIDD1a) gaṇaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā'ti janasamūhaṃ akosallasambhūtā akusalā uṭṭhāpetvā. kusale patiṭṭhāpetī'ti kosallasambhūte kusale ṭhapeti.

examples.text: te āyasmato sāriputtassa imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ sutvā pivanti maññe, ghasanti maññe vacasā c'eva manasā ca, sādhu vata, bho, sabrahmacārī akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetī'ti.

70012.commentary: (VINa) sālavatiṃ kumāriṃ gaṇikaṃ vuṭṭhāpesī'ti nāgarā dve satasahassāni, rājā satasahassan'ti tīṇi satasahassāni, aññañ'ca ārām'uyyāna-vāhan'ādi-paricchedaṃ datvā vuṭṭhāpesuṃ, gaṇikaṭṭhāne ṭhapesun'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho rājagahako negamo sālavatiṃ kumāriṃ gaṇikaṃ vuṭṭhāpesi.
kālass'eva vuṭṭhāya upāhanā omuñcitvā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā dantakaṭṭhaṃ dātabbaṃ, mukh'odakaṃ dātabbaṃ, āsanaṃ paññapetabbaṃ.

70016.meaning2: rose, arose, emerged from, is produced
70016.commentary: (UDa) tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhāsī'ti tato phalasamāpattisamādhito yathākālaparicchedaṃ vuṭṭhahi (THIa) atha vuṭṭhāsin'ti tevijjābhāvappattito pacchā āsanato vuṭṭhāsiṃ.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā satt'āhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisinno hoti vimuttisukhapaṭisaṃvedī. atha kho bhagavā tassa satt'āhassa accayena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhāsi.
rattiyā pacchime yāme, tamokkhandhaṃ padālayiṃ, tevijjā atha vuṭṭhāsiṃ, katā te anusāsanī.
puttā vatthu manussānaṃ, bhariyā ca paramo sakhā, vuṭṭhiṃ bhūtā upajīvanti, ye pāṇā pathavissitā'ti.
saddhā bījaṃ tapo vuṭṭhi, paññā me yuganaṅgalaṃ, hirī īsā mano yottaṃ, sati me phālapācanaṃ.

70020.meaning1: risen (from); got up (from); emerged (from); come out (of)

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā sāy'anhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena nigrodh'ārāmo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi
upajjhāyamhi vuṭṭhite āsanaṃ uddharitabbaṃ. sace so deso uklāpo hoti, so deso sammajjitabbo.
evañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, te bhikkhū tāhi āpattīhi vuṭṭhitā honti, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ, ṭhapetvā gihippaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, ṭhapetvā diṭṭh'āvikammaṃ, ṭhapetvā ye na tattha hontī'ti.

70022.commentary: (ANa) gilānā vuṭṭhito hotī'ti gilāno hutvā pacchā vuṭṭhito hoti.

examples.text: ahaṃ kho gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā. tassa me kāyo dubbalo akammañño. hand'āhaṃ nipajjāmī'ti. so nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhitaṃ kho, gahapati, bhikkhuṃ tayo phassā phusanti, suññato phasso, animitto phasso, appaṇihito phasso'ti.
aham'asmi, bhante, jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto āturakāyo abhikkhaṇ'ātaṅko.

70026.commentary: (DHPa) vuḍḍh'āpacāyino'ti gihissa vā tadahupabbajite daharasāmaṇere'pi, pabbajitassa vā pana pabbajjāya vā upasampadāya vā vuḍḍhatare guṇavuḍḍhe apacāyamānassa, abhivādanena vā niccaṃ pūjentassā'ti attho.

examples.text: jānāti nāma vuḍḍho'ti jānāti, gilāno'ti jānāti, saṅghena dinno'ti jānāti.
abhivādanasīlissa, niccaṃ vuḍḍha-āpacāyino, cattāro dhammā vaḍḍhanti, āyu vaṇṇo sukhaṃ balaṃ.

tena, ānanda, bhikkhunā vuḍḍhataraṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā ek'aṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam'assa vacanīyo, ahaṃ, bhante, itthan'nāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno, taṃ paṭidesemī'ti. so evam'āha, passasī'ti?

70029.meaning1: who ordained late in life; who becomes a monastic when old

examples.text: pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato dullabho vuḍḍhapabbajito. katamehi pañcahi? dullabho, bhikkhave, vuḍḍhapabbajito nipuṇo, dullabho ākappasampanno, dullabho bahussuto, dullabho dhammakathiko, dullabho vinayadharo.

70031.meaning1: paying respect to the elderly; honouring the seniors; venerating the venerable

examples.text: abhivādanasīlissa, niccaṃ vuḍḍh'āpacāyino, cattāro dhammā vaḍḍhanti, āyu vaṇṇo sukhaṃ balaṃ.

70032.commentary: (MNa) punappunaṃ uppajjitvā apar'āparaṃ vaḍḍhanavasena vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ariyaṃ aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ pāpuṇāti dhammesu?
viceyya dānaṃ sugatappasatthaṃ, ye dakkhiṇeyyā idha jīvaloke, etesu dinnāni mahapphalāni, bījāni vuttāni yathā sukhette'ti.

tena kho pana samayena assalāyano nāma māṇavo sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasati daharo, vuttasiro, soḷasavass'uddesiko jātiyā, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lok'āyata-mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.

70035.synonym: akkhāta, udīrita, kathita, pabhāvita, pavutta, bhaṭṭha, bhaṇita, bhāsita, lapita, samudāciṇṇa

examples.text: ayam'pi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutan'ti.
evaṃ vimuttacitto kho, aggivessana, bhikkhu na kenaci saṃvadati, na kenaci vivadati, yañ'ca loke vuttaṃ tena voharati, aparāmasan'ti.
ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekaccassa bhikkhuno evam'assa, taṇhā kho sallaṃ samaṇena vuttaṃ, avijjāvisadoso, chandarāgabyāpādena ruppati.
m'āvoca pharusaṃ kañci, vuttā paṭivadeyyu taṃ, dukkhā hi sārambhakathā, paṭidaṇḍā phuseyyu taṃ.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo, appam'pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.

70042.meaning1: means of gaining victory spoken about

examples.text: pañcame abbhuyyāsī'ti parājaye garahappatto ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ suṇāthā'ti rattibhāge buddharakkhitena nāma vuḍḍhapabbajitena dhammarakkhitassa vuḍḍhapabbajitassa sace rājā imañ'ca upāyaṃ katvā gaccheyya, puna jineyyā'ti vuttajayakāraṇaṃ sutvā abhiuyyāsi.

70064.commentary: (ITIa) iti upāsikāsu bahussutabhāvena satthārā etadagge ṭhapitā paṭisambhidāppattā khujj'uttarā ariyasāvikā satthari kosambiyaṃ viharante kālena kālaṃ satthu santikaṃ gantvā dhammaṃ sutvā antepuraṃ gantvā sāmāvatippamukhānaṃ pañcannaṃ itthisatānaṃ ariyasāvikānaṃ satthārā desitaniyāmena yathāsutaṃ dhammaṃ kathentī attānaṃ parimocetvā satthu santike sutabhāvaṃ pakāsentī vuttañ'h'etaṃ bhagavatā vuttam'arahatā'ti me sutan'ti nidānaṃ āropesi.

70065.meaning1: ?? due to characteristics of wrong behaviour described (in)

70066.meaning1: this was said; this was spoken
70066.notes: always used with reference to a verse in the Sutta Nipāta

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam'antarākathā udapādi, vuttam'idaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā pārāyane metteyyapañhe.
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati. tatra kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi, vuttam'idaṃ, sāriputta, pārāyane ajitapañhe.

tena kho pana samayena assalāyano nāma māṇavo sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasati daharo, vuttasiro, soḷasavass'uddesiko jātiyā, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lok'āyata-mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.

70068.commentary: (DNa) vuttavacanā'pi tan'ti tettiṃsa devaputtā vadanti, mahārājāno vuttavacanā nāma.

examples.text: atha kho, bhante, yen'atthena devā tāvatiṃsā sudhammāyaṃ sabhāyaṃ sannisinnā honti sannipatitā, taṃ atthaṃ cintayitvā taṃ atthaṃ mantayitvā vuttavacanā'pi taṃ cattāro mahārājāno tasmiṃ atthe honti.

70069.meaning1: informed of what was said; (or) the words spoken

examples.text: te vuttavākyā rājāno, paṭiggayh'ānusāsaniṃ, vippasannamanā santā, aṭṭhaṃsu samhi āsane'ti.

70070.meaning1: who speaks the truth (according); who tells the truth (about); who correctly repeats

examples.text: kacc'āhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākaramāno vuttavādī c'eva bhagavato homi, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhāmi, dhammassa c'ānudhammaṃ byākaromi, na ca koci sahadhammiko vād'ānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatī'ti?
idha no, āvuso sāriputta, bhagavā kiṃvādī kim'akkhāyī, kathaṃ byākaramānā ca mayaṃ vuttavādino c'eva bhagavato assāma, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyāma

70071.meaning2: indication the person possessing the consciousness of what is heard

70076.meaning1: in accordance with what has just been stated

examples.text: evaṃ vutt'āhaṃ, bhante, te paribbājake etadavocaṃ, aham'pi kho, bho, na kiñci samaṇassa gotamassa ek'aṃsikaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, sassato loko'ti vā, asassato loko'ti vā
evaṃ vutt'āhaṃ, bhante, te purise etadavocaṃ

70078.meaning1: livelihood; way of being; way of life; behaviour

examples.text: santussako ca subharo ca, appakicco ca sallahukavutti, sant'indriyo ca nipako ca, appagabbho kulesu ananugiddho.
gāth'ābhigītaṃ me abhojaneyyaṃ, sampassataṃ brāhmaṇa n'esa dhammo, gāth'ābhigītaṃ panudanti buddhā, dhamme satī brāhmaṇa vutti'r'esā.

70080.meaning1: living; practising; being in some state
70080.meaning2: having the habit or practice of

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo nīce kule paccājāto hoti, caṇḍālakule vā venakule vā nesādakule vā rathakārakule vā pukkusakule vā dalidde app'annapānabhojane kasiravuttike, yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhati.
nivatth'avatthen'eva gehato nikkhamitvā paramasallekhavuttiko'pi abalabalo amandamando viya paresaṃ acittakarūpena hīḷitaparibhūto hutvā gāmanigamarājadhānīsu ekarattivāsen'eva vicarati.

nivāto nāma nīcamanatā nivātavuttitā, yāya samannāgato puggalo nihatamāno nihatadappo pādapuñchanakacoḷasadiso chinnavisāṇa-usabhasamo uddhaṭadāṭhasappasamo ca hutvā saṇho sakhilo sukhasambhāso hoti, ayaṃ nivāto.

70082.meaning1: (gram) for the sake of protecting prosody

70083.meaning1: with livelihood; with practice; with way of life
70083.meaning2: having the habit or practice of
70083.commentary: (MNa) santatavuttino'ti tass'eva vevacanaṃ, santatajīvikā vā'ti'pi attho. tasmiṃ santatasīle ṭhatvāva jīvikaṃ kappenti, na dussīlyaṃ maraṇaṃ pāpuṇantī'ti attho. (MNa) nipakavuttino'ti paññāya vuttino, paññāya ṭhatvā jīvikaṃ kappenti.

examples.text: santi hi, kandaraka, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe sekkhā santatasīlā santatavuttino nipakā nipakavuttino, te catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacittā viharanti.

70084.meaning2: lived, abided, dwelt, stayed, spent the rainy season
70084.notes: vuttha is often considered the past participle of √vas.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, vuttho me, bhante, sāvatthiyaṃ vass'āvāso. icchām'ahaṃ, bhante, janapadacārikaṃ pakkamitun'ti.

tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū vutthavassā āraññakesu sen'āsanesu viharanti. kattikacorakā bhikkhū, laddhalābhā'ti paripātenti.

70085.meaning1: who has completed the rains retreat

examples.text: ettha dāni, māluṅkyaputta, kiṃ dahare bhikkhū vakkhāma yatra hi nāma tvaṃ, bhikkhu, jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto saṃkhittena ovādaṃ yācasī'ti.
yato ca kho ayaṃ bhavaṃ puriso jiṇṇo hoti vuddho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto, āsītiko vā nāvutiko vā vassasatiko vā jātiyā, atha tamhā paññāveyyattiyā, parihāyatī'ti.
dhīrassa vigatamohassa, pabhinnakhīlassa vijitavijayassa, anīghassa susamacittassa, vuddhasīlassa sādhupaññassa, vesamantarassa vimalassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi
atha kho subhaddo vuddhapabbajito te bhikkhū etadavoca, alaṃ, āvuso, mā socittha, mā paridevittha, sumuttā mayaṃ tena mahāsamaṇena. upaddutā ca homa, idaṃ vo kappati, idaṃ vo na kappatī'ti.

70089.commentary: (ANa) vuddhabhūmī'ti yena kāraṇena vuddho nāma hoti, taṃ kāraṇaṃ.

examples.text: atthi, brāhmaṇa, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena vuddhabhūmi ca akkhātā daharabhūmi ca.

70090.meaning1: developed in virtue; advanced in ethics

examples.text: dhīrassa vigatamohassa, pabhinnakhīlassa vijitavijayassa, anīghassa susamacittassa, vuddhasīlassa sādhupaññassa, vesamantarassa vimalassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi

70091.meaning1: developed in virtue; cultivated in ethics
70091.commentary: (DNa) sīlam'assa atthī'ti sīlavā. vuddhaṃ vaddhitaṃ sīlam'assā'ti vuddhasīlī (MNa) vuddhasīlassā'ti vaḍḍhit'ācārassa. (MNa) vuddhaṃ vaḍḍhitaṃ sīlam'assā'ti vuddhasīlī. (ANa) vuddhasīlino'ti vaḍḍhitasīlā vuddhasamācārā. (THa) saṃsevitavuddhasīlinā'ti saṃsevitaṃ āciṇṇaṃ vuddhasīlaṃ saṃsevitavuddhasīlaṃ, taṃ yassa atthi, tena saṃsevitavuddhasīlinā. atha vā saṃsevitā upāsitā vuddhasīlino etenā'ti saṃsevitavuddhasīlī, tena.

examples.text: susukhumanipuṇ'atthadassinā, matikusalena nivātavuttinā, saṃsevitavuddhasīlinā, nibbānaṃ na hi tena dullabhan'ti.

70092.meaning1: who associates with betters; who consorts with superiors

examples.text: akkhehi dibbanti suraṃ pivanti, yant'itthiyo pāṇasamā paresaṃ, nihīnasevī na ca vuddhasevī, nihīyate kāḷapakkhe'va cando.
vuddhi h'esā, bhagini, ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjatī'ti.
appamattikā esā, bhikkhave, vuddhi yadidaṃ bhogavuddhi. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, vuddhīnaṃ yadidaṃ paññāvuddhi. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, paññāvuddhiyā vaddhissāmā'ti.

70094.meaning1: (gram) (of a vowel sound) strengthening and lengthening (of)

examples.text: 483, 527. asaṃyog'antassa vuddhi kārite.
aññesu ca paccayesu sabbesaṃ dhātūnaṃ asaṃyog'antānaṃ vuddhi hoti. jayati, hoti, bhavati. caggahaṇena ṇupaccayass'āpi vuddhi hoti. abhisuṇoti.

vuddhippatto'smi muddho mama varagaravo sīlapaññ'ādisobhe, cand'ādicc'eva suddhe varajinaṭhapite sāsanābbhe patīte, nissāyevā tipemā paṇamiya sirasā niccam'esaṃ saritvā, pādambhoje guṇagge hataduritamalo ānubhāvena tassā.

70099.grammar: ger of vuddhiṃ anveti, comp vb
70099.meaning1: growing up; getting older; coming of age

examples.text: sa kho so, bhikkhave, kumāro vuddhim'anvāya indriyānaṃ paripākam'anvāya yāni tāni kumārakānaṃ kīḷāpanakāni tehi kīḷati, seyyath'idaṃ, vaṅkakaṃ ghaṭikaṃ mokkhacikaṃ ciṅgulakaṃ patt'āḷhakaṃ rathakaṃ dhanukaṃ.
mahāsatto hi tadā mahati uḷārabhoge kule nibbattitvā vuddhim'anvāya disāpāmokkhassa ācariyassa santike garuvāsaṃ vasanto sabbasippānaṃ nipphattiṃ patvā kulagharaṃ āgantvā
